name: MEIL-NeRF
definition: MEIL-NeRF is a memory-efficient incremental learning algorithm for Neural Radiance Fields that prevents catastrophic forgetting without increasing memory usage by treating the NeRF network itself as a memory storage for pixel RGB values.
summary: MEIL-NeRF is a memory-efficient incremental learning algorithm for Neural Radiance Fields that prevents catastrophic forgetting by using a Ray Generator Network to retrieve past information from the NeRF itself, maintaining constant memory usage.
